user.title: Connect to Sesharo
user.description: Push selected Home Assistant data into Sesharo. Create a Personal Access Token in the Sesharo app (Settings → Developer) and paste it below.

error.invalid_auth: Sesharo rejected the token or user ID. Double-check both.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Sesharo API at that URL.

abort.already_configured: This Sesharo account is already configured.

init.title: Sesharo

discover.title: Suggest entities to track
discover.description: Sesharo scanned your entities and found these that aren't already covered by a preset or an existing mapping. Tick the ones you'd like to track — the signal name, kind and unit are filled in automatically (you can rename them later under Add a custom mapping).

configure_mapping.title: Configure mapping
configure_mapping.description: Mapping {entity}. The signal slug, kind and unit were guessed from the entity — adjust if needed. The slug must be lowercase letters, numbers and underscores (e.g. washer_power).

add_mapping.title: Add a custom mapping
add_mapping.description: Pick the Home Assistant entity to export. The next screen pre-fills the Sesharo signal name, kind and unit from it — you just confirm or tweak.

error.invalid_signal: Signal must be lowercase letters, numbers and underscores (max 49 characters).
